scope: Uncommitted editor-experience changes captured before ablation
method: One design change at a time; preserve controls and failed experiments; retain only simplifications with behavior and performance evidence. No budget increases or test weakening.

experiments.result: 11 pass, 2 fail: same-file and replaced-signature parameter hints disappear

experiments.change: Remove workspace-wide spelling-based parameter-name cache and unused provider arguments, retain local source-order fallback
experiments.result: 13/13 IDE inlay tests and 5/5 config/protocol tests passed
experiments.decision: retain; identity counterexample fixed, default/no-SMT/full protocol gates pass, matched stdio probe passes
experiments.identity_regression: New test passes with removal and fails on baseline: baseline borrows unrelated_name from an unresolved foreign helper.

experiments.change: Use source-map exact span before inference in missing-field/match queries; avoid inferring every callable
experiments.decision: retain; existing source-map prefilter reduces cold-query inference from 201 to 1 callable, field/match protocol and full gates pass
experiments.result: Exact source-map span/file prefilter added before inference; two field-fill protocol tests and match constructor-payload protocol test pass.
experiments.measurement_scope: Five cold databases, 200 unrelated functions before one missing-field target; debug build with identical tracing, not editor latency.

experiments.change: Ablate sufficient arithmetic-premise SMT rewrite versus general bounded-domain proof
experiments.decision: reject; restored dispatch; baseline 79/79 semantic audits pass
experiments.result: 78 semantic audit tests passed, one failed: vector_element_count_uses_product_quotient_premises becomes Unknown without sufficient-premise dispatch.

experiments.change: Ablate specialized positive-factor/power ordering rules independently
experiments.decision: reject both independent removals; restored baseline
experiments.result: Control 79/79 passes; removing natural-power ordering fails power_ordering_requires_natural_ordered_exponents; removing positive-factor rule fails positive_integer_factor_is_bounded_by_its_product (78/79 pass each).

experiments.change: Ablate stale-diagnostic request validation independently of resolve fingerprint
experiments.result: Control passed; without request-time revalidation, stale unused-variable diagnostic offers rename for a binding that is now used. Resolve fingerprint remains present.

experiments.change: Ablate priming panic recovery and free-page reclamation independently
experiments.decision: reject both removals; retain panic recovery and free-page reclamation

panic.method: Inject exactly one panic inside real priming worker; initialize server over stdio, observe progress, reload, observe recovery. Same injected fault with and without catch_unwind.

memory.method: Same final source and release build configuration; ablated binary removes only the release_unused_memory call. All sources restored before sampling. Same stdio workload, separate sequential processes.

behavioral_interfaces: hover limits and scoped member queries

retained_contracts.design: Completion replacement ranges and configuration plumbing
retained_contracts.reason: Primary edit must replace the full token or postfix receiver, preserve existing calls, and honor client snippet support; these are protocol data, not an extra cache or abstraction layer.
A newer syntax wave cannot merge with older semantic results; identical diagnostics still advance the applied generation. Related information/code changes are user-visible.

retained_contracts.design: Canonical callable selection for hints and hover
retained_contracts.reason: Source-order replacement and scoped overloads require definition identity. Only the unscoped spelling-based hint cache was removed.
evidence: cross-file parameter and hover protocol regressions

retained_contracts.reason: Instantiated field types and exhaustiveness witnesses avoid inventing defaults or constructors from global names. Existing BodySourceMap suffices to restrict query work; no new analyzer/cache introduced.

retained_contracts.design: Generated-file registration and typed __virtual manifest values
retained_contracts.reason: Represents upstream manifest semantics and maps real provider files; removal would undo explicitly requested generated-source integration.

retained_contracts.design: Display switches and limits for hints, lenses, tokens and hover
retained_contracts.reason: Connects existing configuration to visible editor behavior and bounds output. No replacement configuration layer or speculative cache added.

retained_contracts.design: Bounded finite-domain proofs and negated comparison edges
retained_contracts.reason: Restore no-SMT conformance without increasing production solver budgets; exhaustive branches share a 64-state cap. Specialized rules remain independently necessary as S1/S2 demonstrate.

measurement_sources.panic_probe_python:
from pathlib import Path
import sys, os, time, json
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('scripts').resolve()))
from editor_probe import Client
root=Path('target/ablation-2026-10-25/panic-project').resolve()
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(root/'main.sail').write_text('function main() -> int = 1\n')
(root/'test.sail_project').write_text('Main { files main.sail }\n')
name=sys.argv[1]
with Path(f'target/ablation-2026-10-25/{name}-stderr.log').open('w') as stderr:
 c=Client(Path('target/debug/sail-lsp').resolve(),stderr)
 try:
  c.ask('initialize',{'processId':os.getpid(),'rootUri':root.as_uri(),'workspaceFolders':[{'uri':root.as_uri(),'name':'panic-project'}],'capabilities':{'window':{'workDoneProgress':True}}},'init',timeout=20)
  c.send('initialized',{})
  deadline=time.monotonic()+10
  while time.monotonic()<deadline and c.prime_failures==0:c.pump(.1)
  initial={'failures':c.prime_failures,'active_progress':list(c.priming)}
  c.send('sail-lsp/reloadWorkspace',None)
  deadline=time.monotonic()+10
  while time.monotonic()<deadline and c.prime_completions==0:c.pump(.1)
  after={'failures':c.prime_failures,'completions':c.prime_completions,'active_progress':list(c.priming)}
  status=c.ask('sail-lsp/analyzerStatus',None,'responsive',timeout=5)
  Path(f'target/ablation-2026-10-25/{name}.json').write_text(json.dumps({'initial':initial,'after_reload':after,'status':status,'events':c.events},indent=2))
  print(name,initial,after,flush=True)
  c.ask('shutdown',None,'shutdown',timeout=5);c.send('exit',None);c.process.wait(timeout=10)
 finally:
  if c.process.poll() is None:c.process.kill();c.process.wait()
measurement_sources.panic_variants_python:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p=Path('crates/sail-lsp/src/main_loop.rs')
base=p.read_text()
root=Path('target/ablation-2026-10-25')
(root/'R1-main_loop.rs').write_text(base)
needle='''                    analysis.parallel_prime_caches(num_worker_threads, &cancel, move |p| {'''
injected=base.replace(needle,'''                    static PANICKED: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool = std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false);
                    if !PANICKED.swap(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst) {
                        panic!("ablation: injected priming worker panic");
                    }
'''+needle)
assert injected!=base
start=injected.index('                let outcome = std::panic::catch_unwind',injected.index('if let Some((_cause'))
end=injected.index('                // Priming\'s temporary workers',start)
block=injected[start:end]
ablated=injected[:start]+block.replace('std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| {','Ok::<_, ()>({').replace('                }));','                });')+injected[end:]
try:
 for name,source in [('R1-panic-control',injected),('R1-panic-ablated',ablated)]:
  p.write_text(source)
  with (root/(name+'-build.log')).open('w') as log:
   subprocess.run(['cargo','+1.97.1','build','-p','sail-lsp','--bin','sail-lsp'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  subprocess.run(['python3',str(root/'probe_panic.py'),name],check=True)
finally:
 p.write_text(base)
